name: Beef Birds in Wine
description: A hearty dish of beef cutlets rolled with a mixture of onions, mushrooms, and parsley, simmered in a rich wine and beef stock sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix onions, mushrooms, garlic, and parsley together.
Roll ¼ of the mixture up in each beef cutlet and secure with toothpicks.
Brown the rolls on all sides in olive oil. Remove rolls and keep warm.
Stir flour into pan drippings. Gradually add liquid and seasonings. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly.
Add meat rolls and simmer, covered, for 45 minutes. Add more liquid if needed.

keywords: beef birds, wine sauce, main dish

_similar.name: Beef Broccoli Stir-Fry
_similar.description: A quick and flavorful stir-fry of beef sirloin and broccoli in a savory soy and oyster sauce mixture.
recipeIngredient: ¾ lb sirloin steak, sliced into 1/8 inch thin strips

recipeInstructions.text: Stir soy sauce into cornstarch in a small cup. Add oyster sauce, salt, and pepper. Stir and set aside.
Heat wok to medium-high. Add the first amount of cooking oil. Add broccoli and stir-fry for 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Transfer to a bowl.
Add the second amount of cooking oil to the hot wok. Add beef strips and stir-fry until desired doneness.
Add broccoli back into the wok. Stir the cornstarch mixture and pour into the beef mixture. Cook until boiling and thickened.

_similar.keywords: beef stir-fry, broccoli, soy sauce, oyster sauce
